cohort: Pregnant women with clinically suspected FGR (n=179) and uncomplicated pregnancies (n=53) who underwent routine obstetric ultrasonography and fetal echocardiography, later categorized into confirmed FGR (n=119) and control (n=113) groups based on neonatal birth weight.
finding: Fetal growth restriction (FGR) is positively related to abnormal umbilical artery flow, placental or umbilical cord anomalies, preterm birth, and emergency cesarean delivery, negatively related to maternal BMI, and is associated with significantly enlarged right heart structures (RAd, RVd, RA/LA, and RV/LV).
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean delivery was positively related to Fetal Growth Restriction (FGR).
cross-section timing: During pregnancy (at the time of routine obstetric ultrasonography and fetal echocardiography)
